items.title: Why ZM Stock Prints So Much Cash Right Now
items.summary: The video-call giant is generating far more cash than the average company, yet the market is treating it like a business in decline. Here’s the offer on the table.

items.title: Has Microsoft Stock Run Ahead Of Its AI Payoff?
items.summary: The software giant's stock has a powerful business engine behind its long-term trend, but a rapid run-up back toward all-time highs forces investors to ask if the price of admission is still worth paying.

items.title: Is BlackBerry Stock Pricing In A Turnaround That Hasn't Arrived?
items.summary: The market is paying a premium valuation for a company delivering modest operational growth, betting that a major turnaround is just around the corner.

items.title: Is Adobe Stock’s AI Strategy Worth The Near-Term Risk?
items.summary: A creative software titan is trading at a steep discount, but a major strategy shift has investors wondering if the price is a bargain or a breakdown.

items.title: How Much Upside Can AAPL Stock's Growth Deliver?
items.summary: At $314.58, Apple (AAPL) looks set up for roughly 38% of upside over the next three years under a conservative scenario. Not a moonshot, but enough to matter if the math holds. Revenue compounding does all the work, because the scenario holds the multiple flat at today's level rather than assuming any re-rating. Here is the operational reality the math is built on.

items.title: Can PLTR Stock Live Up To Its Multiple?
items.summary: This is a hyper-growth chapter for Palantir Technologies. The company now provides a complete sovereign AI stack, with its AIP platform as the core engine for government and commercial clients.

items.title: Figma Stock Rose With Its Peers, Not On Its Own News
items.summary: A one-session jump that its application software peers largely shared says less about Figma than the products it is not yet billing for.

items.title: Palo Alto Networks Stock Surged With The Whole Security Group
items.summary: A single-session gain that looks like a verdict on the company's acquisitions arrived with its rivals repricing alongside it, which leaves the company's own test still ahead.
